contract: Public campaign story and progress lead to a guest donation with exact server fees, hosted checkout and server-confirmed status. Warm editorial direction. See docs/Research/Public campaign UI 2026-11.md.

accessibility.evidence: axe-core WCAG 2 A/AA, 2.1 AA and 2.2 AA: zero violations on desktop/mobile page and native donation dialog. Escape closes and restores focus. Reduced-motion rendering checked. Automated scans do not establish full conformance.

responsive.evidence: Rendered at all target sizes. No horizontal overflow; long content also fits at 320px. Mobile has a fixed donation action and scrollable dialog.

loading.evidence: Streaming loading main observed while campaign data resolved.

empty.evidence: empty-campaign renders missing-photo and zero-supporter states.

error.evidence: unavailable-campaign shows load failure and retry; payments-unavailable shows recoverable fee error.

partial.evidence: partial-campaign retains campaign and raised total while showing recent donations unavailable.

success.evidence: Preview server confirmation renders amount and thank-you; redirect alone does not.

permission.evidence: missing-campaign renders unavailable page; API test rejects private campaign supporter queries.

renderedEvidence.observation: Loaded original preview photograph, progress and donation sidebar.
Responsive content with mobile donation action.
Story heading and photograph fit with fixed donation action.

paymentChecks: Uncertain checkout remains pending after reload; no second checkout action.
Server status change to SUCCEEDED renders thank-you state.
Changed checkout fees require an additional review.
Status capability stored in HttpOnly SameSite=Lax cookie and removed from response JSON.
limits: Provider handoff and settlement were exercised with local fixtures, not live payment credentials.
No new database integration run for the supporter feed; privacy/filter contract covered by unit tests.
200% browser zoom and RTL were planned stress cases but not completed in this review.
